images.title: Each step down divides by 10
images.purpose: Shows 1 divided by 10 three times reaching 1/1000, which is 10 to the power −3, a small positive number and not a negative one.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space, no scenery, no characters. One row of four cards joined by arrows across the middle, and one larger expression centred above the row.
images.exact_structure: One row of exactly 4 equal white rounded cards, evenly spaced from left to right, with thin teal (#0072B2) outlines except the last, which has a thick reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline. The cards read 1, 1/10, 1/100 and 1/1000 in that order. Between neighbouring cards, exactly 3 equal short amber (#E69F00) arrows pointing right, with one label ÷ 10 each step above the middle arrow only. Centred above the row, in larger type, the expression 10 with a small raised exponent −3 at its upper right, followed by = 1/10³. A thin reddish purple line joins this expression to the last card. Exactly 4 cards and 3 arrows. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A negative exponent gives a reciprocal: 10 to the power −3 is 1/1000, not a negative number.
images.description: Shows 1 divided by 10 three times reaching 1/1000, which is 10 to the power −3, a small positive number and not a negative one.
images.context: 10 to the power −3 = 1/10³ = 1/1000; dividing 1 by 10 three times gives 1/1000.

image_decisions.why: Dividing 1 by 10 three times shows that 10 to the power −3 is the small positive number 1/1000.
